==Description==
'''Free Spirit''' is an emote that could have been obtained at Level 39 of the premium [[Null & Void Event#Null & Void Battle Pass|Null & Void Battle Pass]] track. It was made by c4rpye. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. The player can move while performing the emote, though as a ghost, but they are unable to interact with it. The player's [[Nametag]] will be adopted by the ghost too.

When used, the player will die and turn into a ghost. This will make their avatar lie on the ground while all movement will happen through a ghost. Unequipping the emote sends the player back to where it was first used.

It had a cost of {{GumDrops|1,160}} or {{Robux|112}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{GumDrops|20,455}} or {{Robux|3,094}}. Prior to the 20% discount, it had a cost of {{Robux|141}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{Robux|3,886}}.
